verdict.rationale: Jitsu lets you control where data ends up in two ways. It delivers events into your own warehouse or storage of choice (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres, S3, GCS), and it can be fully self-hosted on any on-prem or Kubernetes infrastructure, with Private Cloud and On Prem tiers. Residency control therefore comes from deployment and destination choices rather than an explicit region setting. missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for Jitsu Cloud (e.g. EU/US hosting), explicit residency documentation for data buffered in Jitsu's own Kafka/storage, independent corroboration.
